decisions.reason: As a newly launched formwork system with its own webpage and close fit to the firm's tailored production-line offering, it is worth keeping open because uncertainty remains but carrying costs should be manageable.
This automation-related product supports the firm's stated growth in automation and integrated systems, so despite early uncertainty the option value of staying in the market is high.
The product looks more peripheral and was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, but as a low-cost complementary component it is still premature to abandon after roughly one year.
A dedicated page signals meaningful commercial intent, and as a modular magnetic formwork item it likely costs little to keep available while market feedback continues to develop.
This product appears to be part of the firm's broader modular formwork platform, so keeping it preserves learning and cross-selling potential in an expanding firm and industry.

Because it was only lightly presented and seems to overlap with other magnetic formwork offerings, it is the weakest option and the firm would likely reallocate attention to stronger products and new development.
